json_ld_data.name: Tarot Candle Duo: The Magician & The High Priestess
json_ld_data.description: Where intuition meets action, magic happens. The Intuition & Manifestation Tarot Candle Duo brings together The High Priestess and The Magician, pairing inner wisdom with focused action. The High Priestess invites you to trust your intuition, embrace your power, and let things unfold in their own time. The Magician channels confidence, determination, and the energy to turn ideas into reality. Each candle combines original Tarot artwork, an illuminating reading, and a fragrance crafted to reflect the spirit of the card. The High Priestess features notes of Pomegranate, Red Berries & Patchouli.The Magician features Bergamot, Eucalyptus & Cedar. Light this duo when setting intentions, seeking clarity, or creating your next chapter.
